units.source_text: 啪地一下，他觉得自己从头到脚，都融进了突然喷火似的一幕里。

en.t: With a sharp snap, he felt as though he had melted from head to toe into a scene that had suddenly burst into flame.

units.source_text: 然而，身体的芯，无论如何也融化不了，残留着冰棍似的东西。

en.t: Yet the core of his body would not melt no matter what, and something like an ice stick remained there.

units.source_text: 看来内心还是感到了愧疚。

en.t: It seemed that deep down he still felt guilty.

units.source_text: 没有昨天，也没有明天，像一颗点一样的芯，

en.t: With no yesterday and no tomorrow, a core like a single point,

units.source_text: 这是个自以为可以把他人像擦掉黑板上的粉笔灰一般抹得不留痕迹的世界……

en.t: this was a world that believed it could wipe other people away without a trace, like chalk dust erased from a blackboard...

units.source_text: 他做梦也不会想到，现代社会里竟还有这样野蛮的行径。

en.t: He would never have dreamed that such savage conduct could still exist in modern society.

units.source_text: 他从受惊中缓过劲来，总算可以喘一口气，

en.t: As he recovered from the shock and could finally catch his breath,

units.source_text: 这份愧疚也并不那么坏。

en.t: this guilt did not seem so bad after all.
